about: check reports, as build does and before any input is read, the group-scope and driver-scope refusals and a row filter's phase boundaries (#3229, #2844 decision 3), and the refusals of what the rows read that the declarations decide (#3309). A grouped row reads its driver only at its group keys, in every kind of row derivation, through a lookup's key, range value and derivation, and in the column phase (ROW-5, NAME-4), its aggregate reads only group keys outside its reductions (FORMULA-22) and reduces one relation (LOOKUP-18); a lookup read for one template's rows cannot match on another input's record (LOOKUP-5, LOOKUP-7, LOOKUP-15); a row formula, flag or case predicate reads only its driver's record, and a column formula no qualified name but a lookup's (FORMULA-9); a row filter reads nothing only the column phase completes (ROW-6, LOOKUP-2); require_match and between are refused on a read that is no implicit join, require_match first (LOOKUP-24, LOOKUP-9), and a refused source filter comes first (LOOKUP-8); a flag reads no lookup (FORMULA-9); a template placeholder is text (TEXT-1); and a read of a 1.0 row driver is a lookup that declares no key (LOOKUP-3, ROW-2). The documents: grouped is one template over VS grouped by subject, ungrouped one template over VS with a row per record, two a template over VS and one over HOME whose STUDYID and USUBJID columns derive nothing, implicit has no rows and VS as its base, and keyless has a template over VS and one over DOSES, a lookup of PLAN that drives it and so declares no key. In grouped, ungrouped and two, SEQ is a window, which only the column phase completes, N and M are plain integers, X derives 0.0 and C 'none', and HOME declares its key, the output keys it stores, for the reads that join it (D23); in implicit X derives 0.0; in keyless X derives 0.0 and C 'A', and the dose template derives its own X and C. Each case moved from check_row_scopes.rs runs check and build, which report the same complete rows. Moved from check_row_scopes.rs, whose tests compared check's issues with build's, whole, and the first issue's condition and rule: a case states that issue among the issues by its condition and rule, and case_api_contracts.rs holds it first. A case writes the files its specification names and runs for the default host, since a request without a project reads no environment entry. The cases after a_keyless_row_driver_s_own_template_reads_it_as_its_driver moved from execution_grouped_driver_dataset.rs and execution_window_group_sources.rs, whose tests projected each issue to its phase, condition, rule, spec paths and context, which compares names. A driver field read outside the groups of a grouped template names the driver the read qualifies, the grouped template's own input or named intermediate, under ROW-5 in the template and NAME-4 at column level, and a column window that orders the rows of a template grouped by another driver names both drivers (WINDOW-11). Those tests only built: vitals is a clinic template over CLINIC, then a home template over HOME grouped by subject and day, over clinic and home_readings, and serious one template over the intermediate SER of AE's serious events grouped by subject, over ae. A window that partitions, orders or reads by a driver field is a scalar source of each row: window_row orders a grouped template's own window and window_column a column-level window by ORDER, which each case replaces, over window_source. A field outside the groups is refused by check as by build; a group key or a value of the grouped row checks clean and saves the groups ranked; a refused group read leaves build the unknown field it finds at its own entry, which its test found among the issues by condition and spec paths, while check, not knowing what the source stores, refuses both fields as outside the groups. That test called check, build and save one by one, so each of its cases names the one operation whose result it compared, but the refusal both reported alike, and migrated_api_contracts.json holds the routes and save results its test asserted.

documents.keyless:
yamaa: "1.0"
type: spec
domain: ADVS
keys: [STUDYID, USUBJID, PARAMCD]
input:
  VS: {path: vs.csv, types: {VSDTC: date, VSDY: int, SYSBP: float, DIABP: float}}
  PLAN: {path: plan.csv, types: {DOSENUM: int, PLANDOSE: float, FIRST: int, LAST: int, REF: int}}
intermediates:
  - {id: DOSES, dataset: PLAN, filter: "PLAN.DOSENUM > 0"}
output: {path: out.csv, columns: [STUDYID, USUBJID, PARAMCD, AVAL, X, C]}
columns:
  - {name: STUDYID, type: str}
  - {name: USUBJID, type: str}
  - {name: PARAMCD, type: str}
  - {name: AVAL, type: float}
  - {name: X, type: float, derivation: 0.0}
  - {name: C, type: str, derivation: "'A'"}
rows:
  - id: vs
    dataset: VS
    derivations:
      STUDYID: VS.STUDYID
      USUBJID: VS.USUBJID
      PARAMCD: VS.VSTESTCD
      AVAL: VS.SYSBP
  - id: dose
    dataset: DOSES
    derivations:
      STUDYID: DOSES.STUDYID
      USUBJID: DOSES.USUBJID
      PARAMCD: "'DOSE'"
      AVAL: DOSES.PLANDOSE
      X: 0.0
      C: "'D'"

edits.to:
AVAL: {aggregate: "MAX(VS.SYSBP)"}
      N: {diff: {type: date, start: VS.VSDTC, end: VS.VSDTC, unit: day}}

AVAL: {aggregate: "MAX(VS.SYSBP)"}
      X: {source: {variable: VS.SYSBP, order_by: [VS.VSDY], keep: first}}
{name: C, type: str, derivation: {mapping: {source: VS.VSTESTCD, dict: {"1": one}}}}
{name: X, type: float, derivation: {case: [{when: "VS.SYSBP > 1 AND PLANNED.PLANDOSE > 1", then: 1.0}, {otherwise: 2.0}]}}
{name: X, type: float, derivation: {aggregate: {expr: "COUNT(PLAN.DOSENUM)", key: {DEVICEID: VS.DEVICEID}}}}

dataset: VS
    filter: "SUBJ.PLANDOSE IS NOT NULL"

group_by: [VS.STUDYID, VS.USUBJID]
    filter: "VS.SYSBP > 1 AND SEQ > 1 AND HOME.SYSBP > 1"

AVAL: VS.SYSBP
      X: {source: {variable: VS.SYSBP, between: {value: VS.VSDY, lower: VSDY, upper: VSDY}}}

AVAL: VS.SYSBP
      X: {source: {variable: VS.SYSBP, require_match: true}}

AVAL: VS.SYSBP
      X: {source: {variable: VS.SYSBP, require_match: true, between: {value: VS.VSDY, lower: VSDY, upper: VSDY}}}

AVAL: VS.SYSBP
      X: {source: {variable: AVAL, between: {value: VS.VSDY, lower: VSDY, upper: VSDY}}}

AVAL: VS.SYSBP
      X: {source: {variable: PLANNED.PLANDOSE, require_match: true}}

AVAL: VS.SYSBP
      X: {first_available: {sources: [{variable: VS.SYSBP, require_match: true}, VS.DIABP]}}

AVAL: VS.SYSBP
      C: {mapping: {source: {variable: VS.VSTESTCD, between: {value: VS.VSDY, lower: VSDY, upper: VSDY}}, dict: {"1": one}}}

AVAL: VS.SYSBP
      X: {case: [{when: "AVAL > 1", then: {source: {variable: VS.SYSBP, require_match: true}}}, {otherwise: 2.0}]}
{name: X, type: float, derivation: {source: {variable: VS.SYSBP, require_match: true}}}
{name: X, type: float, derivation: {source: {variable: HOME.SYSBP, require_match: true}}}
- {name: X, type: float, derivation: {source: {variable: VS.SYSBP, require_match: true, between: {value: VS.VSDY, lower: VSDY, upper: VSDY}}}}
- {name: X, type: float, derivation: {source: {variable: PLANNED.PLANDOSE, require_match: true}}}
- {name: X, type: float, derivation: {source: {variable: VSDY, between: {value: VS.VSDY, lower: VSDY, upper: VSDY}}}}
- {name: X, type: float, derivation: {first_available: {sources: [{variable: VS.SYSBP, require_match: true}, VS.DIABP]}}}
- {name: X, type: float, derivation: {case: [{when: "VSDY > 1", then: {first_available: {sources: [{variable: VS.SYSBP, require_match: true}]}}}, {otherwise: 1.0}]}}
- {name: X, type: float, derivation: {source: {variable: VS.SYSBP, require_match: true, filter: "PLAN.FIRST > 1"}}}

AVAL: VS.SYSBP
      X: {source: {variable: VS.SYSBP, require_match: true, filter: "HOME.VSDY > 1"}}

      X: {source: {variable: HOME.SYSBP, require_match: true, between: {value: VS.VSDY, upper: VSDY}}}
